notes.title: Into the Dread - Patch #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I've received both positive and negative feedback on the game, so several bugs have beed fixed with a new balance changes.

FIXES:

Fixed the bug with player that did not play the specific animation.
Fixed bug with door transition animation.


BALANCE CHANGES:

Spray now stack up to 3 items in one slot.
Pills now stack up to 3 items in one slot.
First Aid now heal all player's health.
